[SWS_EthIf_91245] Definition of API function EthIf_SwtEthTxPrepareFrame
Upstream requirements: SRS_Eth_00125
⌈
Service Name
EthIf_SwtEthTxPrepareFrame
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EthIf_SwtEthTxPrepareFrame (
uint8 CtrlIdx,
Eth_BufIdxType BufIdx,
uint8** DataPtr,
uint16* LengthPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0xb5
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different CtrlIdxs. Non reentrant for the same CtrlIdx.
CtrlIdx
Ethernet Controller index
Parameters (in)
BufIdx
Ethernet Rx Buffer index
DataPtr
IN: Pointer to the position of the EtherType of a common Ethernet
frame OUT: Pointer to the position of the EtherType in the
management frame
Parameters (inout)
LengthPtr
IN: Pointer to the length of the buffer without management
information OUT: Pointer to the modified length needed for buffer
and management information
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Frame successfully prepared
E_NOT_OK: Frame preparation failed
Description
Prepares the Ethernet frame for common Ethernet communication (frame shall be handled by
switch according to the common address resolution behavior) and stores the information for
processing of the corresponding TxFinishedIndication call.
Available via
EthIf.h
⌋
